annotations.title: Audit one NF-e or NFC-e XML: totals, CFOP, SEFAZ protocol and CBS/IBS credit

description: Parses one Brazilian NF-e (model 55) or NFC-e (model 65) XML in SEFAZ layout 4.00, including the 2025 tax-reform <IBSCBS> group, into compact JSON with about 90% fewer tokens, then audits it: checks that items, freight, discounts and taxes add up to the invoice total, that CFOPs fit an in-state or interstate operation, that the access key passes Mod-11 and that the embedded SEFAZ protocol says authorised; and, under LC 214/2025, compares the CBS and IBS highlighted per item with the official rates to compute the credit at risk in reais and draft a supplier alert. Use it when an agent receives a purchase invoice to book, pay or reconcile, or must answer questions about one without spending tokens on raw XML. Do not use it for a batch of invoices, which is audit_nfe_xml_batch, for an NFS-e service invoice, whose XML is different, or to confirm the current status at SEFAZ, since a later cancellation does not appear in the XML. Read 'auditReport', then 'rtcCreditAudit' and 'supplierAlert'. Costs 0.010 USDC per call, paid with x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453), a B2B X-API-Key or a Wafermap marketplace signature; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header instead of an exception, and every failure is a JSON body with 'error', so an agent loop never breaks on a thrown error. Pure parsing and arithmetic at the edge: the XML is not stored, SEFAZ is not queried (authorisation is read from the protocol embedded in the XML) and no e-mail is sent.

aiSummary.description: When true (the default) a single-XML audit carries 'aiExecutiveBrief', one Portuguese sentence of at most 38 words with the operation, total, SEFAZ status and credit risk. Set false to skip it and save latency.

auditRtcCredit.description: Run the CBS/IBS tax-credit audit under LC 214/2025 against the official RFB classification tables (default true). Set false for a pure parse-and-totals audit.

buyerRegime.description: Tax regime of the buying company. 'regime_regular' (default) can take CBS/IBS credits, so missing highlights are a loss; 'simples_nacional' changes what counts as credit at risk.

includeItems.description: Include the per-item lines in 'items' (default true). Set false to cut the response size on invoices with hundreds of items.

referenceYear.description: Calendar year whose CBS/IBS transition rates are expected, 2026 to 2033. Defaults to the invoice's issue year, or 2026 when there is none. Drives the expected-credit figures and the 2027 projection.

supplierEmail.description: Optional supplier e-mail, only used to prefill supplierAlert.emailDraft so the alert can be sent with the agent-email API. Nothing is sent by this tool.

xml.description: Full XML text of one invoice, either the authorised <nfeProc> (preferred, it carries the SEFAZ protocol) or a bare <NFe>. Send the XML itself as a string, not a file path, a URL or a DANFE PDF. Text that is not a NF-e or NFC-e returns HTTP 422.

name: audit_nfe_xml

outputSchema.description: Single JSON envelope shared by every tool of this server, because they are three intents over one paid call. Which blocks are present depends on the tool: a single XML fills invoiceSummary, auditReport and, with the credit audit on, rtcCreditAudit and supplierAlert; a batch fills batchSummary, invoices and supplierAlerts; an item list fills rtcCreditAudit and supplierAlert. Amounts are BRL numbers.

accessKeyAudit.description: Mod-11 check and split of the 44-digit access key: accessKey, isValidLength, mod11Valid, expectedDv, actualDv, uf, issueYearMonth, issuerCnpj, model, modelName, series, invoiceNumber.

aiExecutiveBrief.description: One Portuguese sentence summarising a single audited invoice, present unless aiSummary is false.

auditReport.description: Fiscal consistency verdict: status APPROVED, WARNING or REJECTED_MATH_OR_KEY_ERROR; mathConsistent (sum of items, freight, discounts and taxes equals vNF); expectedVNF and actualVNF; cfopScopeConsistent (CFOP first digit matches an in-state or interstate operation); sefazAuthorized (protocol cStat 100); anomalies, a list of Portuguese findings.

batchSummary.description: Batch totals: invoices processed, truncatedAtMax25, invoicesWithCreditRisk, totalInvoiceValueBrl, totalCreditAtRiskBrl, totalOverchargedTaxBrl, totalProjected2027RiskBrl, severityBreakdown and rfbDbVersion.

error.description: Portuguese failure reason, present only on a rejected call: missing input (HTTP 400) or an XML that is not a NF-e or NFC-e (HTTP 422).

invoiceSummary.description: Compressed invoice, about 90% fewer tokens than the XML: modelo, serie, numeroNF, dataEmissao, tipoOperacao, naturezaOperacao, sefazProtocol {nProt, cStat, xMotivo, dhRecbto} or null when the XML has no authorisation protocol, emitente and destinatario {cnpj, cpf, nome, ie, municipio, uf}, itemsCount, totals {vProd, vDesc, vFrete, vNF, vICMS, vPIS, vCOFINS, vCBS, vIBS, vTotTrib, explicitTaxBurdenPct and more}, payments and infCpl truncated to 500 characters.

invoices.description: Batch only: one compact audit per invoice, with a per-invoice error when an XML could not be parsed instead of failing the whole batch.

items.description: Per-item lines with product, NCM, CFOP, quantities and taxes. Present only when includeItems is not false.

mode.description: Present for batch and item-list calls; absent for a single XML.

processingTimeMs.description: Edge processing time in milliseconds, also in the X-Processing-Time-Ms header.

rtcCreditAudit.description: CBS/IBS credit audit under LC 214/2025 with the RFB table version: referenceYear, buyerRegime, severity (ok, missing_credit_highlight, understated_credit or overcharged_tax), hasIbscbsGroupInXml, affectedItemsCount, totalItemsAudited, highlighted and expected {vCBS, vIBS, total}, credit at risk and overcharge in BRL, projections for 2027 and 2033 and per-item findings.

success.description: True when the input was parsed and audited.

suggestedNextSteps.description: Chaining hints for autonomous agents, such as sending supplierAlert.emailDraft with the agent-email API. Purely advisory.

endpoint.description: Absolute HTTPS endpoint of the follow-up API.

priceUsdc.description: Price of the follow-up call in USDC.

tool.description: Tool name of the suggested follow-up API.

when.description: Condition under which the follow-up is worth making.

supplierAlert.description: Ready-to-act supplier notice: actionRequired, severity, priority, supplier {cnpj, name, uf, crt, isSimplesNacional}, invoiceRef, financialImpactBrl {creditAtRiskCurrentYear, overchargedCurrentYear, projectedImpact2027, projectedImpact2033}, affectedItemsCount, recommendedAction and, when action is required, emailDraft {toHint, subject, bodyText, suggestedEndpoint, suggestedPayloadTemplate} to pass to the agent-email API. Nothing is sent by this server.

supplierAlerts.description: Batch only: one supplierAlert for every invoice that needs action.

tokenMetrics.description: Token accounting for XML input: rawXmlBytes, cleanJsonBytes, rawXmlTokensEst, cleanJsonTokensEst, tokensSaved and savingsPercent, at about 4 characters per token.
